feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting
entry.summary: President Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi on Thursday for a historic three-way meeting.

entry.title: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's joint summit with leaders of China and Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks to Nicholas Burns, former U.S. ambassador to China and NATO, about President Trump's planned meeting with the leaders of China and Russia.

entry.title: White House withdraws nominee for FDA commissioner
entry.summary: Ahead of an anticipated Senate committee vote, the Trump administration has withdrawn the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton to be the next Food and Drug Administration commissioner.

entry.title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that
entry.summary: The Trump administration's sweeping changes to SNAP food aid mean older adults up to age 65 must work or volunteer to get the benefit.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: President Trump is in China for a meeting with its leader and Russia's Putin, Nvidia holds first earning call since CEO's resignation, concerns grow after ongoing tech outages nationwide.

entry.title: Netflix's 'The Altruists' tells the story of Sam Bankman-Fried
entry.summary: The Sam Bankman-Fried story is fictionalized in the new Netflix series "The Altruists." NPR's Leila Fadel talks with actor Julia Garner and showrunner Graham Moore.

entry.title: Families of victims of D.C.-area midair collision push for more safety measures
entry.summary: Families of people killed in a midair crash in Washington, D.C., pushed lawmakers for more safety measures, amid the Trump administration calls for $50 billion after Friday's nationwide ground stop.

entry.title: Voyager One becomes the first spacecraft to reach one light-day from Earth
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with NASA's Nicky Fox about the legacy of Voyager 1 and its achievement of traveling one light-day from Earth.

entry.title: Air Force major arrested for protesting Trump is being held in solitary, lawyer says
entry.summary: Air Force Maj. Jason Watson was arrested after protesting the Trump administration while on the U.S. Capitol steps in uniform. His lawyers say he has been held in solitary confinement ever since.

entry.title: Orchestra of Israeli and Palestinian musicians continues to make music
entry.summary: A group of Israeli and Palestinian musicians remains committed to making music together as part of a groundbreaking orchestra.
